query:
SELECT
                    id,
                    slug,
                    title,
                    content,
                    published_at,
                    created_at,
                    updated_at,
                    created_by,
                    updated_by
                FROM news
                WHERE (
                    ($3::bool AND published_at IS NOT NULL)
                    OR ($4::bool AND published_at IS NULL)
                )
                AND (
                    $5::TEXT IS NULL
                    OR title ILIKE '%' || $5 || '%'
                    OR content ILIKE '%' || $5 || '%'
                )
                ORDER BY
                    COALESCE(published_at, created_at) DESC,
                    id DESC
                LIMIT $1
                OFFSET $2
